# benchmark-cost-per-task

> AI agent benchmark for cost per deterministically verified back-office result.

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/benchmark-cost-per-task
Repository: https://github.com/pooriaarab/benchmark-cost-per-task
Directory: https://private-repo-337e.com/benchmarks/benchmark-cost-per-task

## Data and grading

The package contains 30 seeded synthetic episodes: 10 invoice calculations, 10 CRM updates, and 10 file edits. The grader replays tool calls against a fresh virtual workspace and requires an exact final state plus finish_task.

Provider cost is authoritative. Missing cost is estimated from token counts and the live or committed OpenRouter price catalogue. Unknown costs remain null.

## Exports

The root exports benchmark, run, score, addEfficiency, compareReports, renderEfficiency, and renderComparison. benchmark-cost-per-task/api exports the fetch-style handler. benchmark-cost-per-task/mcp exports MCP builders.

## Commands

The CLI supports list, show, run, score, compare, card, provenance, index-entry, serve, and mcp. Use `run --provider mock` for offline verification. Pass `--tasks <file>` (or `run({ tasks })`, or `?tasks=` on the API) to evaluate an alternate JSONL split. Version 0.2.0 changes cost aggregation; 0.1.0 scores are not comparable.

## Environment

OpenRouter reads OPENROUTER_API_KEY. OpenAI-compatible providers read OPENAI_BASE_URL and OPENAI_API_KEY. Repository files never supply provider keys.

## Verification

Run `npm run ci:local`. The E2E report is `artifacts/e2e-report.json`.
